name: Default
shortDescription: Self-hosted music server for collectors, with album releases, song versions, music videos, metadata providers and scrobbling, backed by PostgreSQL, Meilisearch and RabbitMQ.

alerts.message: The first account you create becomes the admin. Register it right after deploying; later accounts must be enabled by an admin.
Meelo has no upload feature: copy your music into the data volume mounted at /data, then create a library in Settings > Libraries with a path relative to /data and run a scan.
